name: generate_image
description:
Generate an image from a text prompt; pass reference_images as an array of image paths for image-to-image.
Uses the configured OpenAI or RightCode image API. Each reference_images entry takes the same kind of reference vision_analyze accepts; on messaging platforms a reference must be attached to the current turn, listed in the chat history as context_image_N, or a trusted avatar URL. Emits an image event and returns a local path. Messaging platforms deliver emitted images automatically, so do not pass the same image to send_message_to_user. Do not call print_image unless the user explicitly asks to display it.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images for image-to-image. Each value takes the same forms as vision_analyze's image: a local image path, an http(s) image URL, or a context_image_N from the chat history.
